title: Data Preprocessing Basics: Understanding Independent vs Dependent Variables

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome to this tutorial.
cues.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到這堂課。

cues.en: Okay we are almost ready to begin our journey of data pre-processing, but first we need to get the data set.
cues.zh: 資料前處理的旅程快要開始，但首先必須取得資料集。

cues.en: So that's what we are going to do in this tutorial.
cues.zh: 這就是這堂課要做的事。

cues.en: So let's do this right now.
cues.zh: 現在開始。

cues.en: And here it is.
cues.zh: 資料就在這裡。

cues.en: Just gonna put the column titles in bold.
cues.zh: 我先把欄位標題加粗。

cues.en: Okay that's the data set.
cues.zh: 這就是資料集。

cues.en: So what is this data set about?
cues.zh: 它記錄什麼內容？

cues.en: This data set contains four columns; country, age, salary, and purchased, and 10 lines, 10 observations.
cues.zh: 資料集有 Country、Age、Salary、Purchased 四欄，以及十列，也就是十筆觀測值。

cues.en: And basically this contains informations of customers of some company.
cues.zh: 基本上，這是一家公司客戶的資料。

cues.en: And the first three columns are informations of these customers like the country, the age, and the salary.
cues.zh: 前三欄是客戶資訊，包括國家、年齡與薪資。

cues.en: And the fourth column purchased here tells if yes or no the customer bought the product of the company.
cues.zh: 第四欄 Purchased 則表示客戶是否購買公司的產品。

cues.en: So we have to distinguish something very important here that we will distinguish for the rest of the course.
cues.zh: 這裡要先分清一件非常重要的事，後面整門課都會用到。

cues.en: It's the difference between the independent variables and the dependent variables.
cues.zh: 就是自變數與依變數的差別。

cues.en: So the independent variables of the first three columns, country, age, and salary.
cues.zh: 自變數是前三欄：Country、Age、Salary。

cues.en: And the dependent variable is purchased here, the fourth column.
cues.zh: 依變數則是第四欄 Purchased。

cues.en: And in any machine learning model we are gonna use some independent variables to predict a dependent variable.
cues.zh: 任何機器學習模型，都是利用一些自變數，來預測依變數。

cues.en: So that means here that with this three first columns this three independent variables, we are going to predict if yes or no the customer purchased a product.
cues.zh: 在這裡，就是利用前三欄、三個自變數，預測客戶是否購買產品。

cues.en: Okay so that's the first distinction that we really need to understand.
cues.zh: 這是第一個務必理解的區別。

cues.en: And it's very important to do this section because the data pre-processing steps that we're gonna do in this section, we will have to do it for all the machine learning models we are going to make.
cues.zh: 這一章非常重要，因為這裡的資料前處理步驟，之後建立每一種模型都會需要。

cues.en: So it's really essential to know how to manage this, but don't worry it's gonna be very simple.
cues.zh: 因此，掌握做法很重要，但不用擔心，它會很簡單。

cues.en: And besides, I'm gonna give you at the end of this section of template that will allow us later to pre-process the data in a flashlight for all the machine learning models we're going to make.
cues.zh: 而且章節結尾會提供模板，之後建立各種模型，都能迅速完成資料前處理。

cues.en: So I look forward to starting these steps with you.
cues.zh: 期待和你一起開始這些步驟。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
